svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 06 · Merced · 09/12 Merced River (Common)
svg.desc: Cottonwoods, gravel bars, slow green water. The cool place to be when the valley heat sets in. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
